evidence_quotes: Loteamento clandestino em área de mananciais. Reposição da área a seu estado anterior.
Desfazimento de loteamento clandestino em área de mananciais.
rationale: This TJSP decision concerns joint municipal and state liability for failing to inspect and halt an illegal land subdivision (loteamento clandestino) in a watershed protection area (área de mananciais), ordering the undoing of the subdivision and restoration of the area to its prior state. Under the protocol rules, Brazilian mananciais watershed protection enforcement is classified as WATER under mananciais_calibrated_label and environmental_protection under governance_category_21, while strict_service_access_label is UNCERTAIN because the dispute exclusively involves land-use/demolition enforcement in a watershed protection zone without direct water utility service access or water abstraction/effluent pollution adjudication.
